text: It was so efficient and comfortable. When I went back to buy two at .... I used to be a professional chef and have used many spatulas. The 1st Chefn Switchit Narrow Silicone Spatula I bought was at a hardware store. After using it I bought another one as gift for a friend who loves to cook but was not a professional. The spatula was well made but nothing last forever. It  got beat up because it was the only one I used, It was so efficient and comfortable. When I went back to buy two at the hardware store they no longer carried them. I didn't save the packaging so no brand name to search. It took awhile on a internet search but I found them and bought two immediately. Would I recommend this spatula? What do you think.

description: Breeze through food preparation tasks with the beautifully designed Chef'n Switchit Narrow Silicone Spatula (Cherry). Stir, scoop, spread, mix, and move foods with this double-sided kitchen tool. Save steps and cleaning time with this tool featuring different sized silicone spatulas on each end. Perfect for spreading, scraping, and serving straight from the stovetop, the flexible spatulas are safe for non-stick cookware. Reach into smaller jars and other containers with the small spatula. Easily clean this tool in the top rack of the dishwasher.
